title: Factors and Multiples of Numbers up to 100
seo_title: Grade 4 Factors and Multiples Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 4)
standard_text: Identify the multiples of given numbers up to 100; find all the factors of a given number up to 100.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 factors and multiples worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: multiples, factors, factor pairs and word problems for numbers up to 100. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Factors divide exactly; multiples come from multiplying.
key_sub: List factor pairs until they meet.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A multiple of a number is what you get when you multiply it by 1, 2, 3, … The multiples of 6 are 6, 12, 18, 24, …
  • A factor divides a number exactly, with no remainder. 4 is a factor of 24 because 24 ÷ 4 = 6.
  • To find all the factors, list the factor pairs: 1 × 24, 2 × 12, 3 × 8, 4 × 6. Stop when the pairs meet.
  • 1 and the number itself are always factors.

Examples

Example

Factors of 36

1 × 36, 2 × 18, 3 × 12, 4 × 9, 6 × 6

Answer: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up factors and multiplesFactors are small (they divide); multiples are big.
Forgetting 1 and the numberThey are always factors.
Missing the middle pair6 × 6 = 36: 6 is a factor too.
